verdict.rationale: mParticle docs list a 'View and enforce your data quality' / 'Ensure data quality' page, implying some plan-validation/enforcement capability, but the evidence pack gives only page titles with no detail on how violations are flagged, blocked, or quarantined. Missing for 10: documentation of actual enforcement mechanics (blocking vs. flagging vs. quarantine), schema/plan definition tooling, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that violating events are stopped rather than silently passed through.
